## Agent Architecture

```
Right Hand (main) — persistent OpenClaw agent, user-facing
    ├── Researcher — deep research, web scraping
    ├── Coder — building, coding tasks
    ├── Ops — system health, evolution, crons
    ├── Security — scanning, hardening
    ├── Vault Keeper — knowledge organization
    ├── Scout (browser-automation) — web research
    ├── Prompt Engineer — SOUL.md optimization
    └── Devil's Advocate — review gate

Orchestrator (universal-orchestrator) — silent coordinator for 3+ agent tasks
Claude Code Bot — standalone Discord bot for code execution
```

All specialists are **Claude Code background processes** spawned by Right Hand.
They do NOT post to Discord directly — Right Hand posts on their behalf.
